facts.label: Online participation expected
facts.detail: Standard online university courses follow a course calendar and require academic participation. Access is flexible, but simply viewing a course does not satisfy engagement requirements. This does not establish a live meeting time for a particular course.

facts.label: Online assessment formats vary
facts.detail: Standard online university courses can use written assignments, discussions, proctored or nonproctored examinations, or other comprehensive assessments. The exact assessments for an individual university course are not classified here; this does not describe outside providers or every TESU credit-earning method.

facts.label: Four-week course options
facts.detail: TESU offers four-week accelerated sections for undergraduate learners as a separate course format. A specific course’s accelerated section and registration dates must be available; this standard online-course baseline does not assume those alternatives or promise a completion date.
